jobs.title: Drift Wood #10 · the bus driver
jobs.prompt: a four-panel comic strip laid out as a two-by-two grid on a half page, thin black panel borders (4 panels). Style: black and white comic strip panel, scratchy crow-quill pen and ballpoint ink on cardstock, harsh photocopy contrast, heavy black spotting, jagged uneven line weights, 1990s indie comix zine style, xerox grain, no color, no gray tones. Cast, drawn the same in every panel, ages exactly as given: WOOD — aged 18, gaunt boy drawn a head too tall, oversized thrift-store wool overcoat to the knee worn indoors, faded black tee, dark jeans, sneakers, a bristol pad clutched flat to his chest, chin up. Title of the strip: DRIFT WOOD. The strip: Godard, to a man who has driven the same road for twenty-two years. Panel 1: the front of a school bus on a foggy morning, a teenage boy in an overcoat leaning forward from the first seat toward a weathered driver who keeps his eyes on the road (in this panel: WOOD). Wood says "Godard said a story should have a beginning, a middle, and an end, but not necessarily in that order.". Panel 2: close-up of a school bus driver's eyes in the rear-view mirror, weathered face. Driver says "Twenty-two years. Same road. Beginning's the bay. End's the school.". Panel 3: a teenage boy sitting back in a bus seat, delighted (in this panel: WOOD). Wood says "And the middle?". Panel 4: a school bus small on a two-lane coastal highway between walls of black spruce in fog, wide and quiet. Driver says, in a small balloon, "This.". Lettering: every balloon and caption contains its complete text exactly as written, in clean hand-lettered comic capitals, large enough to read; size each balloon to fit its whole sentence and never cut a word at a balloon or panel edge; no words other than the ones given. Bottom right margin: tiny signature "A. Finch — Small Wood, OR" beside a tiny stylized gull, two strokes. Reference @chloe_17 is the model sheet for CHLOE: match that face, build, hair and clothes exactly. Reference @gully_17 is the model sheet for GULLY: match that face, build, hair and clothes exactly. Reference @wood_20 is the model sheet for WOOD: match that face, build, hair and clothes exactly. Match the attached references: @chloe_17 for the character the strip's Chloe at 17; @gully_17 for the character the strip's Gully at 17; @wood_20 for the character Wood at 20-23.
